description: This Dart source file implements a fake download engine for testing or UI purposes. The class FakeDownloadEngine manages in-memory download records, simulates download progress, and provides methods to enqueue, cancel, list, and retrieve downloads. It is designed as a deterministic mock with quick completion times, mainly for testing and UI wiring, without real network activity.

classes.name: FakeDownloadEngine
classes.description: A mock implementation of a download engine that manages in-memory download states and simulates download progress.

methods.name: cancelAll
methods.description: Cancels all active fake downloads, clears timers, and marks non-completed downloads as canceled.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Adds a new download record to the in-memory store and simulates its completion after a short delay.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels a specific download by content ID, removing its timer and marking it as canceled.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of all current download records sorted by creation time.

methods.name: getByContentId
methods.description: Retrieves a particular download record by its content ID.
